title: None Shall Escape the Judgement
studio_context: Treasure Isle, Kingston, 1974: a song by Earl Zero that Cornell Campbell turned down, voiced by Johnny Clarke over a rhythm the Aggrovators made in a jam; Clarke's breakthrough.

drum_performances.name: Carlton 'Santa' Davis
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The flying cymbal: the hi-hat opened on every off-beat and closed on the beat, taken from MFSB's Philadelphia sound; the record Davis and Wikipedia credit with making it reggae's sound of the mid-1970s, and Bunny Lee put it on everything after.

notable_moments.description: The hat opened on every "and" through the whole record, brought up by King Tubby in the mix.
